# Quarterly results

The table below gives revenue and headcount for each region over the last four quarters. Figures are in thousands of dollars.

| Region | Q1 | Q2 | Q3 | Q4 | Headcount |
|:--|--:|--:|--:|--:|--:|
| North America | 1,200 | 1,420 | 1,515 | 1,610 | 48 |
| South America | 310 | 335 | 352 | 360 | 12 |
| Europe | 980 | 1,010 | 1,045 | 1,120 | 37 |
| Middle East | 145 | 160 | 171 | 188 | 6 |
| Africa | 88 | 94 | 102 | 117 | 5 |
| Asia | 760 | 812 | 870 | 905 | 29 |
| Oceania | 220 | 231 | 240 | 252 | 9 |
| Total | 3,703 | 4,062 | 4,295 | 4,552 | 146 |

Growth was strongest in North America and Asia. Europe recovered in the second half after a slow start, and the smaller regions grew steadily from a low base.
